author: Fextralife
description:
Titan Quest 2 GAMEPLAY Discussion - 2 MONTHS Until 1.0 LAUNCH!!
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking a little bit more about Titan Quest 2. This is a game that I've covered a few times on the channel, and it's no secret that Titan Quest 1 is probably my favorite RPG of all time. So when THQ Nordic announced they were getting a sequel, it was definitely a very welcome surprise. And after spending about a year in early access with steadily adding more content, the game has improved over its course of development. And with the full release fast approaching on January 19th of next year, it's time to take another look at the game and see what we can look forward to its official release.
